notes: Telit LE910Q1 cellular support and OTA modernization. Migrates the cellular data path from Quectel EC25 (QMI+PPP) to Telit LE910Q1 (RNDIS, mdm0 interface). Introduces a modular OTA hook system so future deployment changes ship without touching update-station.sh. Modernizes the /modem API so the LCD, web UI, and check-ins share one cached mmcli poller instead of each forking subprocesses.
features: Telit LE910Q1-WWG modem support end to end (enable/disable, udev, NetworkManager profiles); cellular data path switches from PPP to RNDIS using the modem's mdm0 netdev.

Modular OTA hook system: post-merge.sh orchestrator iterates post-merge.d/ drop-ins (install-systemd, install-udev, install-network). Adding a new subsystem deploy is now a single file drop, not an update-station.sh edit.
Pre-merge OTA hook orchestrator wired in as a placeholder phase for future pre-pull tasks.
Adaptive /modem cache in hardware-server: one background mmcli poll loop serves all consumers, polls every 2 s while active, idle after 60 s, exposes real RSRP / RSRQ / SNR via mmcli --signal-setup.
Connectivity probe for /modem/ppp: actual ping through the modem interface every 10 s while active, replacing the old 'any modem interface exists' check that misled the LED on unprovisioned modems.
Modem boot-state persistence: operator on/off intent survives hard reboots via a marker file (modem-boot-state.service).
IMEI-gated boot-time RNDIS NV provisioner for Telit modems; subsequently moved to manufacturing.
sensorgnome.service and bootcount.service brought under monorepo + OTA control; boottime_compute.sh moves into system/scripts/.
78-ctt-radios.rules: positive-filter radio identification by USB VID:PID via udev (replaces fragile by-path substring matching).
tools/modem-snapshot.sh: read-only diagnostic dump capturing mmcli / ip / dmesg state for support escalations.
Wired uplink default-route metric pinned below cellular so eth0 wins when both interfaces are present.
list-devices.sh extended to recognize the new Telit modem.
bugs: Fix boot deadlock where check-sim-id started ModemManager too early, before the SIM was ready.

Fix LCD modem signal showing ':!' for working RNDIS modems; the old state check required state=='connected' but ModemManager never advances past 'registered' on the RNDIS path. Accepts more states plus requires a numeric signal value.
Fix /modem/ppp false positives on unprovisioned modems whose mdm0 came up without LTE forwarding (LED stayed on with no real connectivity).
Fix sensorgnome.service first-boot ENOENT race against /etc/ctt/station-id by adding After=station-boot.service.
Fix FunCube USB endpoints crowding the bus: 77-ctt-telit-block-unused.rules now also blocks Telit interfaces 06 / 07.
Fix missing executable bit on modem-boot-state.sh.
removed: Automatic station reboot at the end of update-station.sh; reboots are now operator-driven.
provision-modem.service (CGDCONT cleanup, PPP era) — replaced by the RNDIS data path.
provision-modem-rndis.service and boot-time RNDIS NV provisioning — moved to manufacturing; stations now assume the modem ships pre-provisioned.
